visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Replace br tags with list styling
visualizerParams.problemDescription: This menu is made of links separated by line breaks. Use a ul with li items. The text of the links must stay.

solution.explanation: Items that belong together are a list. The markup then says so, and CSS can lay out the items however you like, instead of using br tags only to push things down.

checks.label: The links read One, Two, Three
